prompt.project_info: Create a realistic portrait of an original approved adult woman seated inside a vintage car.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult blonde woman with softly waved hair, natural makeup, and a relaxed confident smile sits in the rear seat of a vintage cream-colored car. She wears a long-sleeved red ruched dress with an off-shoulder neckline, sheer black tights, and a delicate necklace.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 portrait from outside the open car door, subject seated against cream vinyl upholstery, one arm resting along the seat and the other hand near her face, vintage door hardware, brick-and-metal exterior visible through the windows, and natural car-interior framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft daylight entering through the car windows, warm muted interior tones, gentle highlights on red fabric and hair, nostalgic relaxed retro-fashion atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic smartphone fashion photography, vertical 9:16, medium-full-body seated framing, 50mm perspective, moderate depth of field, natural fabric and upholstery texture, restrained color, no artificial HDR look.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic vertical 9:16 fashion portrait of an original approved adult blonde woman with softly waved hair, natural makeup, and a relaxed confident smile seated in the rear seat of a vintage cream-colored car. She wears a long-sleeved red ruched dress with an off-shoulder neckline, sheer black tights, and a delicate necklace. Photographed from outside the open car door, with cream vinyl upholstery, vintage door hardware, and brick-and-metal exterior visible through the windows. Soft daylight, warm muted tones, nostalgic retro-fashion atmosphere, natural texture, realistic smartphone photography.
